summary: Tested Node.js/Express backend + React Design Studio feature end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering analytics (count_documents fix verified), templates CRUD, events, bulk certificate generation, PDF download with custom template layout, send-email, revoke. Frontend: Design Studio navigation, canvas rendering, add field, mouse-drag position update, template save/update/save-as-copy/delete, live preview mode (drag disabled), background image upload/clear all verified. Full integration Design Studio -> Bulk Generator -> PDF download works (PDF is 3.7KB, %PDF header, correct Content-Type).

integration_issues.flow: Design Studio -> Bulk Generator template list refresh
integration_issues.issue: When a new template is created in Design Studio, App.js's `templates` state is not refreshed automatically. The new template does not appear in the Bulk Generator's template <select> until the user manually reloads the page or triggers fetchAllData. Design Studio maintains its own local template state and does not notify the parent App. UX impact: user must reload to use a freshly-designed template. Suggested fix: lift templates state up or pass a refresh callback (like `notify`) from App into DesignStudio and call it after save/delete.

action_items: OPTIONAL/UX: After template save/delete in DesignStudio, refresh templates in parent App.js (pass a refresh callback prop from App to DesignStudio) so Bulk Generator picks up newly-designed templates without a page reload.

OPTIONAL: Seeded templates (tpl-modern, tpl-classic, tpl-tech) in the current DB were created by an earlier server version and have empty `fields` arrays; seedInitialData skips on non-empty collection. If pristine seed is desired, either version-check the seed or add missing fields to those docs via a migration.
critical_code_review_comments: DesignStudio.jsx line 83: loadTemplate uses uid() which is declared with const on line 88. Works at call-time (function body executes after module init) but slightly fragile - move uid definition above loadTemplate for clarity.
App.js maintains its own `templates` state that is only refreshed on mount/after certain actions. Consider a shared context or React Query for template data to avoid stale UI across tabs.
server.js: seed function should be idempotent per-record (upsert by id) rather than skipping when collection non-empty, so schema evolutions to seeded records are picked up.
server.js: PUT /api/templates/:id accepts arbitrary body fields without Pydantic-style validation; consider request-body validation (Joi/zod) for robustness.
seed_data_creation: Test data (PW_ prefixed) created transiently and cleaned up during tests.
